versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the european-patent-claims-review skill.
- Provides structured review of European patent claims in Chinese or European contexts.
- Checks EPC compliance, clarity, support, sufficiency, novelty/inventive step, and unity.
- Outputs clear tables of key issues, revision suggestions (conservative, balanced, fallback), and specification alignment.
- Offers actionable, agent-style feedback focused on practical drafting and prosecution.
- Requires MCP service configuration for database-supported analysis; outlines fallback guidance if not configured.
